description: This Java source file defines the ProcessingController class, which provides REST endpoints for triggering OCR processing on receipt documents within a receipt and expense management platform. It uses Spring annotations for REST controller behavior and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: ProcessingController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints to trigger OCR processing on receipt documents.

methods.name: triggerOcr
methods.description: Handles POST requests to trigger OCR on a document identified by the provided ID.
